source_locator: Consolidated Presidential Primary Election statement of votes, document page 124 of 176 (PDF page 255), City of Bakersfield Mayor, Total row: 447 precincts, total votes 37,326, Harvey L. Hall 34,776 (93.17 percent)
verification_note: Kern County Official Final Results (report dated 06/27/12) list one candidate for City of Bakersfield Mayor, Harvey L. Hall, with 34,776 votes. The Total Votes column shows 37,326, which is larger than Hall's votes, and the table has no write-in column, so the remaining 2,550 are not attributed to any candidate in this document. Only the winner is recorded, so the build treats this as uncontested. The page header prints the date July 5, 2012, but the cover page reads June 5, 2012, and that is the election date. Charter section 67.1(b) makes a majority winner at the nominating election the mayor. The Charter text was not re-opened (HTTP 403 from the live site, JavaScript-loaded in the archive copy). The November 6, 2012 statement of votes (Internet Archive capture 20130411213900) was opened and searched: it lists Bakersfield contests only for council wards 2, 4, 5 and 6 and school board seats, with no mayoral contest, so no second mayoral round occurred. The county PDF was opened through the Internet Archive capture of the county host elections.co.kern.ca.us.

source_locator: Final Summary, page 3 of 4, City Of Bakersfield Mayor (262 of 262 precincts reported), total 72,523
verification_note: Kern County official final results for the March 3, 2020 primary list Karen Goh 60,579 (83.53 percent), Gregory Tatum 7,336 (10.12 percent), Caporali 4,519, and write-ins Hudson 74 and Harrington 15. Goh received more than half of the votes, so Charter section 67.1(b) makes her elected at the nominating election. The document was printed April 3, 2020.

source_locator: City of Bakersfield Mayor contest, printed pages 5279-5382 (PDF pages 6053-6156); Kern County - Total row on PDF page 6155, total votes 53,774
verification_note: Kern County statement of votes for the March 5, 2024 primary lists two candidates for City of Bakersfield Mayor: Karen Goh 44,735 (83.19 percent) and Gregory Tatum 9,039 (16.81 percent). The two totals sum to the 53,774 total votes on PDF page 6156. Goh received more than half of the votes, so Charter section 67.1(b) makes her elected at the nominating election. The document was printed April 2, 2024.
